name: Singlife Davao Marathon
short_description: The Singlife Davao Marathon is a full-marathon race held on August 15, 2026, at SM City Lanang in Davao City, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Singlife Davao Marathon is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 15, 2026, in Davao City, Philippines, organized by RUNRIO Inc. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, starting and finishing at SM City Lanang. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining any of these distance categories.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit various runner levels
Organized by RUNRIO Inc., an established race organizer
Convenient venue at SM City Lanang in Davao City

faqs.question: When is the Singlife Davao Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Singlife Davao Marathon is scheduled to take place on August 15, 2026. This date applies to all distance categories offered at the event, which are hosted at SM City Lanang in Davao City, Philippines, and organized by RUNRIO Inc.

faqs.question: What distances can I run?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance options: the full marathon at 42.195km, a half marathon at 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This variety allows runners of different experience levels and goals to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Where is the race venue?
faqs.answer: The Singlife Davao Marathon takes place at SM City Lanang, located in Davao City, Philippines. This venue serves as the central hub for the race, hosting all four distance categories offered as part of the event on August 15, 2026.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Singlife Davao Marathon is currently open. Interested runners can sign up for any of the four available distances—42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, or 5km—ahead of the event date on August 15, 2026, at SM City Lanang.
